src='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]!=0]
    ib=max(i for i,j in cells)

    for i,j in cells:
        nj=i+j-ib
        if 0<=nj<w: out[i][nj]=grid[i][j]
    return out
'''
